verses.original: Καὶ μεθ’ ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατ’ ἰδίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai meth’ hēmeras hex paralambanei ho Iēsous ton Petron kai Iakōbon kai Iōannēn ton adelphon autou kai anapherei autous eis oros hypsēlon kat’ idian
verses.literal: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter James and John the brother of James and led them up . . . . . . a high mountain by themselves
verses.literalPt: SEIS dias depois, tomou Jesus consigo a Pedro, e a Tiago, e a João, seu irmão, e os conduziu em particular a um alto monte,

verses.original: καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαμψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος τὰ δὲ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο λευκὰ ὡς τὸ φῶς
verses.transliteration: kai metemorphōthē emprosthen autōn kai elampsen to prosōpon autou hōs ho hēlios ta de himatia autou egeneto leuka hōs to phōs
verses.literal: There He was transfigured before them His face shone like the sun and His clothes became as white as the light
verses.literalPt: E transfigurou-se diante deles; e o seu rosto resplandeceu como o sol, e as suas vestes se tornaram brancas como a luz.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἠλίας συλλαλοῦντες μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai idou ōphthē autois Mōusēs kai Ēlias syllalountes met’ autou
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . Moses and Elijah appeared before them talking with Jesus
verses.literalPt: E eis que lhes apareceram Moisés e Elias, falando com ele.

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ Κύριε καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι εἰ θέλεις ποιήσω ὧδε τρεῖς σκηνάς σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ Ἠλίᾳ μίαν
verses.transliteration: apokritheis de ho Petros eipen tō Iēsou Kyrie kalon estin hēmas hōde einai ei theleis poiēsō hōde treis skēnas soi mian kai Mōusei mian kai Ēlia mian
verses.literal: Peter said to Jesus Lord it is good for us to be here If You wish I will put up three shelters one for You one for Moses and one for Elijah
verses.literalPt: E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: Senhor, bom é estarmos aqui; se queres, façamos aqui três tabernáculos, um para ti, um para Moisés, e um para Elias.

verses.original: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ νεφέλη φωτεινὴ ἐπεσκίασεν αὐτούς καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eti autou lalountos idou nephelē phōteinē epeskiasen autous kai idou phōnē ek tēs nephelēs legousa Houtos estin ho Huios mou ho agapētos en hō eudokēsa akouete autou
verses.literal: While Peter was still speaking a bright cloud enveloped them and a voice from the cloud said This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased Listen to Him
verses.literalPt: E, estando ele ainda a falar, eis que uma nuvem luminosa os cobriu. E da nuvem saiu uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu amado Filho, em quem me comprazo; escutai-o.

verses.original: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: kai akousantes hoi mathētai epesan epi prosōpon autōn kai ephobēthēsan sphodra
verses.literal: When the disciples heard this they fell facedown . . . . . . in terror
verses.literalPt: E os discípulos, ouvindo isto, caíram sobre os seus rostos, e tiveram grande medo.

verses.original: Καὶ προσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἁψάμενος αὐτῶν εἶπεν Ἐγέρθητε καὶ μὴ φοβεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: Kai prosēlthen ho Iēsous kai hapsamenos autōn eipen Egerthēte kai mē phobeisthe
verses.literal: Then Jesus came over and touched them Get up He said Do not be afraid
verses.literalPt: E, aproximando-se Jesus, tocou-lhes, e disse: Levantai-vos, e não tenhais medo.

verses.original: ἐπάραντες δὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν οὐδένα εἶδον εἰ μὴ αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον
verses.transliteration: eparantes de tous ophthalmous autōn oudena eidon ei mē auton Iēsoun monon
verses.literal: And when they looked up . . . . . . . . . they saw no one except . . . . . . Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, erguendo eles os olhos, ninguém viram senão unicamente a Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Μηδενὶ εἴπητε τὸ ὅραμα ἕως οὗ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγερθῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai katabainontōn autōn ek tou orous eneteilato autois ho Iēsous legōn Mēdeni eipēte to horama heōs hou ho Huios tou anthrōpou ek nekrōn egerthē
verses.literal: As they were coming down . . . the mountain Jesus commanded them Do not tell anyone . . . about this vision until . . . the Son of Man has been raised from the dead
verses.literalPt: E, descendo eles do monte, Jesus lhes ordenou, dizendo: A ninguém conteis a visão, até que o Filho do homem seja ressuscitado dentre os mortos.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες Τί οὖν οἱ γραμματεῖς λέγουσιν ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsan auton hoi mathētai legontes Ti oun hoi grammateis legousin hoti Ēlian dei elthein prōton
verses.literal: The disciples asked Him Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first
verses.literalPt: E os seus discípulos o interrogaram, dizendo: Por que dizem então os escribas que é mister que Elias venha primeiro?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἠλίας μὲν ἔρχεται καὶ ἀποκαταστήσει πάντα
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ēlias men erchetai kai apokatastēsei panta
verses.literal: Jesus replied Elijah does indeed come and he will restore all things
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Em verdade Elias virá primeiro, e restaurará todas as coisas;

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι Ἠλίας ἤδη ἦλθεν καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτὸν ἀλλὰ ἐποίησαν ἐν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἠθέλησαν οὕτως καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει πάσχειν ὑπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin hoti Ēlias ēdē ēlthen kai ouk epegnōsan auton alla epoiēsan en autō hosa ēthelēsan houtōs kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou mellei paschein hyp’ autōn
verses.literal: But I tell you that Elijah has already come and they did not recognize him but have done to him whatever they wished In the same way . . . the Son of Man will suffer at their hands . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas digo-vos que Elias já veio, e não o conheceram, mas fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram. Assim farão eles também padecer o Filho do homem.

verses.original: τότε συνῆκαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι περὶ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: tote synēkan hoi mathētai hoti peri Iōannou tou Baptistou eipen autois
verses.literal: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist
verses.literalPt: Então entenderam os discípulos que lhes falara de João o Batista.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντων πρὸς τὸν ὄχλον προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἄνθρωπος γονυπετῶν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontōn pros ton ochlon prosēlthen autō anthrōpos gonypetōn auton
verses.literal: When they came to the crowd a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him
verses.literalPt: E, quando chegaram à multidão, aproximou-se-lhe um homem, pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, e dizendo:

verses.original: καὶ λέγων Κύριε ἐλέησόν μου τὸν υἱόν ὅτι σεληνιάζεται καὶ κακῶς πάσχει πολλάκις γὰρ πίπτει εἰς τὸ πῦρ καὶ πολλάκις εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ
verses.transliteration: kai legōn Kyrie eleēson mou ton huion hoti selēniazetai kai kakōs paschei pollakis gar piptei eis to pyr kai pollakis eis to hydōr
verses.literal: Lord have mercy on my son he said He has seizures and is suffering terribly He often falls into the fire or into the water
verses.literalPt: Senhor, tem misericórdia de meu filho, que é lunático e sofre muito; pois muitas vezes cai no fogo, e muitas vezes na água;

verses.original: καὶ προσήνεγκα αὐτὸν τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν αὐτὸν θεραπεῦσαι
verses.transliteration: kai prosēnenka auton tois mathētais sou kai ouk ēdynēthēsan auton therapeusai
verses.literal: I brought him to Your disciples but they could not heal him
verses.literalPt: E trouxe-o aos teus discípulos; e não puderam curá-lo.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη ἕως πότε μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἔσομαι ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν φέρετέ μοι αὐτὸν ὧδε
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen Ō genea apistos kai diestrammenē heōs pote meth’ hymōn esomai heōs pote anexomai hymōn pherete moi auton hōde
verses.literal: O unbelieving and perverse generation - Jesus replied How long . . . must I remain with you How long . . . must I put up with you Bring the boy here to Me
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Ó geração incrédula e perversa! até quando estarei eu convosco, e até quando vos sofrerei? Trazei-mo aqui.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὸ δαιμόνιον καὶ ἐθεραπεύθη ὁ παῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης
verses.transliteration: kai epetimēsen autō ho Iēsous kai exēlthen ap’ autou to daimonion kai etherapeuthē ho pais apo tēs hōras ekeinēs
verses.literal: Then Jesus rebuked the demon and it came out of the boy and he was healed from that moment
verses.literalPt: E, repreendeu Jesus o demônio, que saiu dele, e desde aquela hora o menino sarou.

verses.original: Τότε προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ κατ’ ἰδίαν εἶπον Διὰ τί ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἠδυνήθημεν ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Tote proselthontes hoi mathētai tō Iēsou kat’ idian eipon Dia ti hēmeis ouk ēdynēthēmen ekbalein auto
verses.literal: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked Why couldn’t we drive it out . . .
verses.literalPt: Então os discípulos, aproximando-se de Jesus em particular, disseram: Por que não pudemos nós expulsá-lo?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς Διὰ τὴν ὀλιγοπιστίαν ὑμῶν ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως ἐρεῖτε τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ Μετάβα ἔνθεν ἐκεῖ καὶ μεταβήσεται καὶ οὐδὲν ἀδυνατήσει ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ho de legei autois Dia tēn oligopistian hymōn amēn gar legō hymin ean echēte pistin hōs kokkon sinapeōs ereite tō orei toutō Metaba enthen ekei kai metabēsetai kai ouden adynatēsei hymin
verses.literal: Because you have so little faith - He answered . . . For truly I tell you if you have faith the size of a mustard seed you can say to this mountain Move from here to there and it will move Nothing will be impossible for you
verses.literalPt: E Jesus lhes disse: Por causa de vossa pouca fé; porque em verdade vos digo que, se tiverdes fé como um grão de mostarda, direis a este monte: Passa daqui para acolá, e há de passar; e nada vos será impossível.
Mas esta casta de demônios não se expulsa senão pela oração e pelo jejum.

verses.original: Συστρεφομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Μέλλει ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Systrephomenōn de autōn en tē Galilaia eipen autois ho Iēsous Mellei ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidosthai eis cheiras anthrōpōn
verses.literal: When they gathered together in Galilee Jesus told them The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men
verses.literalPt: Ora, achando-se eles na Galiléia, disse-lhes Jesus: O Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens;

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθήσεται καὶ ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: kai apoktenousin auton kai tē tritē hēmera egerthēsetai kai elypēthēsan sphodra
verses.literal: They will kill Him and on the third day He will be raised to life And the disciples were deeply grieved
verses.literalPt: E matá-lo-ão, e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará. E eles se entristeceram muito.

verses.original: Ἐλθόντων δὲ αὐτῶν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθον οἱ τὰ δίδραχμα λαμβάνοντες τῷ Πέτρῳ καὶ εἶπαν Ὁ διδάσκαλος ὑμῶν οὐ τελεῖ τὰ δίδραχμα
verses.transliteration: Elthontōn de autōn eis Kapharnaoum prosēlthon hoi ta didrachma lambanontes tō Petrō kai eipan Ho didaskalos hymōn ou telei ta didrachma
verses.literal: After they had arrived in Capernaum the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas
verses.literalPt: E, chegando eles a Cafarnaum, aproximaram-se de Pedro os que cobravam as dracmas, e disseram: O vosso mestre não paga as dracmas?

verses.original: Λέγει Ναί Καὶ ἐλθόντα εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν προέφθασεν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Τί σοι δοκεῖ Σίμων οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τίνων λαμβάνουσιν τέλη ἢ κῆνσον ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῶν ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων
verses.transliteration: Legei Nai Kai elthonta eis tēn oikian proephthasen auton ho Iēsous legōn Ti soi dokei Simōn hoi basileis tēs gēs apo tinōn lambanousin telē ē kēnson apo tōn huiōn autōn ē apo tōn allotriōn
verses.literal: Yes he answered When Peter entered . . . the house Jesus preempted him What do you think Simon He asked From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes from their own sons or from others
verses.literalPt: Disse ele: Sim. E, entrando em casa, Jesus se lhe antecipou, dizendo: Que te parece, Simão? De quem cobram os reis da terra os tributos, ou o censo? Dos seus filhos, ou dos alheios?

verses.original: Εἰπόντος δέ Ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἄρα¦Γε ἐλεύθεροί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοί
verses.transliteration: Eipontos de Apo tōn allotriōn ephē autō ho Iēsous Ara¦Ge eleutheroi eisin hoi huioi
verses.literal: From others Peter answered Then the sons are exempt Jesus said to him
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Dos alheios. Disse-lhe Jesus: Logo, estão livres os filhos.

verses.original: ἵνα δὲ μὴ σκανδαλίσωμεν αὐτούς πορευθεὶς εἰς θάλασσαν βάλε ἄγκιστρον καὶ τὸν ἀναβάντα πρῶτον ἰχθὺν ἆρον καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ εὑρήσεις στατῆρα ἐκεῖνον λαβὼν δὸς αὐτοῖς ἀντὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina de mē skandalisōmen autous poreutheis eis thalassan bale ankistron kai ton anabanta prōton ichthyn aron kai anoixas to stoma autou heurēseis statēra ekeinon labōn dos autois anti emou kai sou
verses.literal: But so that we may not offend them go to the sea cast a hook and take the first fish you catch When you open its mouth you will find a four-drachma coin Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours
verses.literalPt: Mas, para que os não escandalizemos, vai ao mar, lança o anzol, tira o primeiro peixe que subir, e abrindo-lhe a boca, encontrarás um estáter; toma-o, e dá-o por mim e por ti.
